aiNative.agentMissing: The client required by this plugin was not found
aiNative.groupsDisabled: Routing groups are turned off. Enable the feature to serve requests through groups.
aiNative.redirectRefused: The local AI runtime redirected the request. Forwarding was refused; refresh and retry.
aiNative.requestFailed: The AI service request did not finish: {{error}}
aiNative.searchAll: Search on behalf of every model offered search
aiNative.searchAllHint: Search on behalf of models that already support search.
aiNative.searchFallbacks: Following search models or services (one ID per line)
aiNative.replyAsked: The model name the caller requested
aiNative.refusalRetries: Additional attempts after a safety refusal
aiNative.refusalRetriesHint: Empty or -1 tries all available members. 0 returns the refusal without another attempt.
aiNative.claudePrintModeHint: Runs each request through claude -p; off prefers interactive mode.
aiNative.agentCompactsHint: Clients can override the general compaction window. Without an override they follow the general setting. These options do not modify other apps' configurations on their own.
aiNative.mcpRouterHint: Find and call tools for the task, keeping their permission limits.
aiNative.routerAllToolsHint: When off, find and call tools on demand to reduce context used by tool definitions.
aiNative.template.smart: Hard to strong, easy to cheap
aiNative.templateNeed.providers: Needs models from two providers; {{name}} is the only one.
aiNative.replaceImportedGroup: Replace an existing group with the same ID
aiNative.replaceImportedGroupHint: Replaces only the group named by the import, not providers or accounts.
aiNative.http1Hint: For custom endpoints with unstable HTTP/2. TLS verification remains enabled.
aiNative.inlineImages: Send DeepSeek images inline each turn
aiNative.inlineImagesHint: When off, DeepSeek's own API uploads images once and reuses their file IDs.
aiNative.passErrors: Let the caller handle upstream errors
aiNative.passErrorsHint: Preserve vendor errors without retries, failover or resting keys for those errors.
aiNative.keepSelf: Allow routing back to this gateway
aiNative.keepSelfHint: Only for a remote Magpie provider that points to itself. Excluded by default to avoid loops.
aiNative.useFirst: Prefer this provider in Smart routing
aiNative.useFirstHint: Quota, rate-limit and availability protections still apply.
aiNative.accountModelsAll: Keep explicit all-model choices for keys
aiNative.accountModelsAllHint: Maps key IDs to explicit all-model choices so fetching models does not narrow them.
aiNative.searchCountHint: 1–20; 0 uses the default of 6. An explicit caller count takes precedence.
aiNative.mixSearch: Search together with other selected APIs
aiNative.mixSearchHint: Query selected APIs in parallel, merge their pages and remove duplicates.
aiNative.retryAfterCapHint: Empty uses the default. Limits the reported wait without ending the account rest early.
aiNative.followLead: Follow the lead agent's current model
aiNative.invalidRuntime: AI services returned an invalid local runtime address. Refresh the page.
aiNative.invalidResponse: AI services returned an invalid response. Try again.
aiNative.responseTooLarge: The response is too large. Narrow the query.
aiNative.findGroupsHint: Group models of the same name served by multiple providers.
aiNative.templatesHint: Build complete templates from available models. Missing models are explained.
aiNative.deleteGroupHint: Deleting a group does not delete providers or accounts. Clients using it may need to select another model.
aiNative.strategyHint: Account, quota and failure protections remain active. The strategy orders eligible members.
aiNative.sinkHint: Try temporarily rate-limited members after the other available members.
aiNative.patienceHint: 0 uses the default of 60 seconds; -1 does not wait again.
aiNative.contextHint: 0 is automatic; -1 uses the smallest member's window.
aiNative.unlistMembers: Offer members only through their group
aiNative.patterns: Model patterns (one per line; * or re:)
aiNative.offeredLevels: Offered reasoning levels (one per line, lowest first)
aiNative.membersHint: Add models or nested groups, then set their order, reasoning levels and fast mode.
aiNative.memberOrder: Matched member order (one ID per line)
aiNative.accountsHint: Providers with no accounts selected use all of their available accounts.
aiNative.rulesHint: Checked in order. All configured conditions of a rule must match.
aiNative.timeZone: Time zone (e.g. Asia/Shanghai; empty follows this computer)
aiNative.weekDays: Weekdays (mon–sun, one per line; empty means daily)
aiNative.optionsObject: Enter a valid JSON object. The current draft is not saved.
aiNative.removePluginHint: Accounts, tools and pages provided by this plugin will be unavailable. Other clients are not uninstalled.
aiNative.pluginTrustHint: Installing runs third-party code. GitHub results are not reviewed endorsements. Check the source, README and permissions.
aiNative.pluginInstallHint: Supports npm packages, Git repositories and local folders.
aiNative.mirrorHint: Prefer mirrors in China. A custom registry takes precedence.
aiNative.maskingRecordsHint: See the types masked, warned about or blocked. Original sensitive values are available only while retained in runtime memory.
aiNative.clearRecordsHint: Immediately delete saved masking records. This cannot be undone and does not disable masking.
aiNative.maskPreviewHint: Preview saved privacy settings, up to 64 KiB. Preview text is not recorded.
aiNative.valueNotRetained: The original value is no longer in memory and cannot be recovered. No original value is read from disk.
